phase: v2.0 Phase R — official historical recovery and comparability (2026-11-10)

policy.scope: Every country × indicator × frequency contract found in the national, monthly, regional and Serbia stores; formal estimation frames are listed but not extended.
policy.expected_periods: From the earlier of the first admitted and first official period to the later of the last admitted and last official period, at the contract's own frequency; indicators are never assumed to start in the same year.
policy.no_imputation: Nothing is interpolated, estimated or zero-filled; missing periods are classified, not filled.
policy.comparability: Common periods are the intersection of actually admitted periods of series with the same definition, unit, frequency and territorial scope (regional: comparable_stable_code years only); never a min/max intersection.

frozen_formal_frame.note: World Bank WDI panel used by frozen formal models; not extended (formal model input). Descriptive equivalents are inventoried above.

bilateral_fx_local_per_eur.definition_check: different currencies: levels are not comparable across countries

policy_rate.definition_check: official policy rates; instruments differ by central bank (see floors.instrument_notes)
